text.p: Tropical Storm Enrique has 60 mph winds and is about 970 miles southwest of southern tip of Baja, California, moving west at 15 mph. It is expected to intensify to hurricane strength in 24 hours. It is only a minor threat to shipping at this time.

Tropical Depression Three has formed in the North Atlantic about 280 miles south-southeast of Cape Hatteras, North Carolina. This system is expected to intensify over the next 24-36 hours. This is only a risk to shipping and boating at this time.
There are no further statements at this time.
